@bobylito So you're suggesting something like this? (pseudocode) ``` {{ hitsWidget }}
{{ customWidget({asc: 'productsAsc', desc: 'productsDesc'}))}} {{ customWidget({asc: 'productsPriceAsc', desc: 'productsPriceDesc'}))}}
``` We were trying to create a single widget for the entire thing, so that we could pass a single `columns` array and not have to worry as much about our column counts lining up.
